app.about.title: About mctool
app.cli.description: mctool GUI (Tkinter): Minecraft save reader/editor (auto version detection; supports {versions}).
app.cli.mc_version_help: When the save version is unsupported, choose which supported version's processing logic to use (e.g. 1.21.1); supported saves are detected automatically and need no flag.
app.cli.self_test_help: Close the window automatically after startup and print check results (for automated acceptance)
app.cli.tab_help: Initial tab index: 0=World Info 1=Blocks 2=Block Search 3=Block Entity Search 4=Player Data 5=Mod Data 6=Raw NBT 7=Verify/Backup
app.cli.world_help: World folder to open at startup (contains level.dat); the MCTOOL_WORLD environment variable is also supported
app.dialog.choose_world_dir: Select the Minecraft world folder (contains level.dat)
app.error.no_world_reload: No world is open; cannot reload level.dat.
app.error.path_empty: Enter a world folder path first.
app.error.run_background_args: run_background requires callable fn and on_done
app.error.tk_init: Error: cannot initialize the Tk GUI (a desktop environment may be unavailable): {error}
app.hint.lock: Hint: the tool holds an exclusive session.lock while a world is open; it is released when the window closes or you use File → Close World. Edits are written immediately and backed up automatically.
